rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both memoranda describe named taxpayers seeking private relief from a statutory filing deadline, recount the untimely filing, reject relief because it would discriminate against similarly situated taxpayers and create an undesirable precedent, and conclude with the same distinctive sentence. C02 and C21 share closely related tax-refund and limitations machinery, but their language and operative progression are less nearly identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Granting special relief in this case, where a refund was not claimed in the time and manner prescribed by law, would constitute a discrimination against other taxpayers similarly situated and would create an undesirable precedent.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The granting of special relief in this case would constitute an unfair discrimination against other taxpayers similarly situated and would create an undesirable precedent which might encourage other taxpayers to seek relief in the same manner.
shared_material.explanation: This is a highly specific, near-verbatim policy conclusion tied to private tax relief from an expired filing period.

shared_material.child_excerpt: On June 30, 1952, more than four years after assessment of the deficiencies and more than two years after the partial payments of the assessment, the taxpayer filed a claim for refund.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Accordingly, the filing of the elections was delayed for more than six weeks after the 30-day period prescribed by law for the filing of such elections.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same administrative sequence: identify the statutory deadline, establish the taxpayer's late filing, and then reject a bill that would waive the consequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under the circumstances, therefore, I am constrained to withhold my approval of the bill.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Under the circumstances, therefore, I am constrained to withhold my approval of the bill.
shared_material.explanation: The identical closing reinforces the close drafting relationship when combined with the distinctive shared substantive paragraph.
